data_protection.basis: Published by the source as open data under CC BY 4.0; Veldris's legitimate interest in letting evaluators assess Midgard's maritime picture with real traffic. Small craft are pseudonymised.
data_protection.notes: AIS static data keyed by MMSI: name, call sign, IMO number, destination, ETA and dimensions. 212 of 1,065 records are small craft (no IMO number, hull under 24 m) and were pseudonymised with `convert.py screen --apply` (name and call sign removed, MMSI replaced by small-craft-<n>). The rest are mostly commercial ships; a vessel of 24 m or more without an IMO number may still be privately owned.
